study: Franka cable: fresh seed cohorts and a separate action-gain control

consumer_adapter_repair.scope: Pass the parent allocation to train/evaluate subprocesses; no learner, MDP, network, loss, hyperparameter, schedule, fixture or budget change

historical_scope: Oct 27 seeds 0/1 used older Isaac/Newton/runtime sources and are not pooled with this merged-source study.
diagnostic_sampling: Public training diagnostics retain iteration1 and every25th iteration, including2000. Points are exact recorded values, not averages; full private audited curves remain preserved.
production_cache_scope: Per-run production clocks use shared on-disk caches already warmed by fixtures/smokes. They include worker imports, environment construction and cache loading, not the allocation's initial cold setup/first compilation.

A.scope: Actual first-smoke command start through final production evaluation/controller exit, including waits; installation, source/fixture upload and later bundling/retrieval excluded.

B.scope: Actual first-smoke command start through final production evaluation/controller exit, including waits; installation, source/fixture upload and later bundling/retrieval excluded.

C.scope: Actual first-smoke command start through final production evaluation/controller exit, including waits; installation, source/fixture upload and later bundling/retrieval excluded.

figures.name: learning-transitions
figures.caption: Each line is one observed seed/allocation. Every point uses the same 128 first episodes, full cable gravity and final action-rate penalty. Ever-goal is segment-6 distance below 5 cm, without a grasp/contact condition; occupancy uses the full episode budget and final hold requires the last 15 scored steps. Evaluation transitions are outside this training budget.

figures.name: learning-wall
figures.caption: Each line is one observed seed/allocation. Every point uses the same 128 first episodes, full cable gravity and final action-rate penalty. Ever-goal is segment-6 distance below 5 cm, without a grasp/contact condition; occupancy uses the full episode budget and final hold requires the last 15 scored steps. Checkpoint write-finished time is an availability clock; final portable policy availability precedes the separate full replay export. Full parent process time is shown separately.

figures.name: execution-costs
figures.caption: All observed seeds are retained. Production uses on-disk compiler caches warmed by fixtures and all four smokes. These are warm-cache complete process clocks, not cold installation/compilation comparisons. Startup components sum the recorded environment startup, learner constructor and prepare calls; imports, initial loads, resets and other process work can sit outside that subtotal. Training loop and checkpoint/replay IO are nested in full training-process time and must not be added to it. SAC includes its final 10M replay export. Evaluation is a separate complete process. These host/process clocks include trajectory-dependent physics, resets, bridges, logging, cache loading and IO; they do not isolate learner-kernel speed.

figures.name: quality-time
figures.caption: One point per complete training/evaluation run. This places task outcomes beside full process costs without assuming equivalent quality. There are no significance tests, confidence intervals or universal timing claims; seed, GPU, execution position and cache history remain confounded.

figures.name: action-reward-diagnostics
figures.caption: These are the final training iteration's recorded values over 1024×24 transitions, without smoothing. The left panel uses normalized policy/replay coordinates before the task action gain; dimensions 0–6 drive arm joints and dimension 7 drives the gripper. RMS and abs(action)>1 fractions do not establish actuator saturation or exploration coverage. The right panel contains each actual task-weighted reward contribution including control_dt, before SAC reward normalization; the physical CPU audit checks their sum against mean transition reward. Different trajectories and resets can change every term.

figures.name: sac-learning-diagnostics
figures.caption: Points retain exact recorded values every 25 iterations after readiness, without averaging or smoothing. Each metric is the last available value for its key within an iteration; actor, temperature and critic keys can originate from different update calls. The entropy metric is not a measured physical rollout standard deviation. These signals support diagnosis but do not establish why a policy succeeds or fails. Temperature uses a logarithmic axis.

figures.name: action-gain-control
figures.caption: Gain1 uses the matching primary official Torch runs; gain 3 uses two additional official Torch runs on allocation D. The original canonical policy/state files are adopted byte for byte. All eight action dimensions are multiplied before the stock task boundary, so arm targets, gripper limit clipping and action-dependent rewards can all change. Replay actions and entropy remain in normalized policy coordinates. Device, chronology, cache history and stochastic trajectories can differ. An outcome difference does not isolate a physical mechanism.
